records.title: Adaptable Logical Control for Large Language Models
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。Adaptable Logical Control uses an HMM approximation to guide an LLM with logical constraints at decoding. The primary text establishes constrained-generation behavior, not lower latency or increased throughput; a systems relation is plausible but unproven.
